name: @enkaku/plugin-mikrotik-routing
description: MikroTik routing — assigns a farm device its own internet egress path by writing policy routing rules on a MikroTik router. Stage 2 (plan 122 §5, step 122.6): the write path (createRule/updateRule/deleteRule), an apply service gated on the local-exception check (§3.2), and the Assignments tab.
